title: rec-c1-6-lifecycle-retention-wire
summary: Close REC-C1.6: lifecycle-safe delete_session (typed SessionStillActive on a still-live probe — no silent probe_stop, no partial state) and retention/tail facts on the wire (retention.retained_from_seq + history_truncated, tail.state + tail.tail_seq) plus a structured CursorStale envelope. REC-C1.0 first commit reconciles the C1.5 closure drift in docs/ROADMAP.md, reconstruction-contracts.toml (active_gate REC-C0 -> REC-C1.6) and the cycles/index.md row coverage.

commits.title: docs(rec-c1.6): reconcile C1.5 closure + C1.6 active in roadmap

gates.smoke_subset_note: Per AGENTS.md §2 the subset is selected from diff scope: this cycle touches chronos-services (Liveness port + RetentionFacts/TailFacts), chronos-mcp (delete_handler + events_read envelope + CursorStale json content), and chronos-sandbox (lifecycle_delete.rs + wire_retention_facts.rs). All three new suites plus restart_uat are mandatory in T4-smoke; e2e_connectivity is the regression baseline.
